name: Dumpling fold-off
summary: A two-minute timing game: a chopstick sweeps along a dumpling wrapper's edge and you pinch when it's in the green for a neat pleat; eight pinches make a dumpling that joins everyone's in a steamer basket with their faces, and the neatest fold wins a small stake.
useWhen: quick game before dumpling night, loser folds
who's actually good at folding dumplings
settle who picks the order at the dumpling place
something to play while we wait for the table
fold-off, arun says he has rice cooker hands
dontUseWhen: a parking or driving game (use sube-park)

place.description: Where the dumplings happen, e.g. 'Golden Lantern, Friday'

prize.description: What the neatest fold wins, as a short line

folds.description: Dumplings already in the steamer, up to 8
